quality.description: No fixture combines a nonzero intrinsic component tensor with a nonzero parallel-axis offset. For example, the 12 kg 2x4x6 block displaced from a second body, with the analytic I = I_cg + m(r²E − rrᵀ) result. Every parallel-axis fixture uses zero-inertia point masses, and the only nonzero-intrinsic multi-component case has coincident CGs. So the summing of intrinsic and shift terms is only covered separately.

quality.description: If the 32-iteration Jacobi loop exits without reaching the 1e-15 off-diagonal threshold, the diagonal is still checked as if it held the eigenvalues. Non-convergence is not reported. For 3x3 symmetric matrices with largest-pivot rotation this is practically unreachable. As hardening, raise ValueError on non-convergence instead of continuing.
quality.evidence: for _ in range(32): ... if abs(second[p][q]) <= 1e-15: break — no else-branch handling before the realizability check.

validation.criterion: T1.3.1-a: arithmetic correctness of component mass, CG and inertia (incl. parallel-axis terms and units) against independently checkable synthetic fixtures
validation.expected: Fixtures with hand-checkable analytic results for total mass, combined CG, parallel-axis diagonal and negative-product off-diagonal terms in SI units, and an implementation matching them.
validation.observed: I recomputed the fixtures by hand and they agree with the code. Equal masses (3 kg at ±2 m) give Iyy = Izz = 24. Unequal masses (1 kg at the origin, 3 kg at (4,8,12)) give CG (3,6,9) and tensor [[156,-24,-36],[-24,120,-72],[-36,-72,60]], consistent with reduced mass 3/4 × (d²E − ddᵀ). The block 12 kg with sides 2/4/6 gives 52/40/20. The CLI off-axis case gives Ixy = −2. The rotated linear body gives C eigenvalues 3,0,0. The README example gives 2 kg, Iyy = Izz = 2. The source applies I_component + m(r²E − rrᵀ) with off-diagonal −m·rᵢrⱼ, consistent with the stated −∫xy dm convention. The Jacobi rotation formulas are consistent with tan2θ = 2a_pq/(a_qq − a_pp). Translation invariance, order independence, scaling (63 = 7·3²) and extreme-magnitude cases are also covered. The test count (8 + 17 = 25) matches the recorded gate. One gap: no combined intrinsic-plus-offset fixture (low finding).

quality.description: A DONE metadata clause counts as a completion `records` link unless it contains one of remain|remains|future|parent|open|deferred. Wording that is common in this repository, such as 'in progress', 'pending', 'started' or 'retained', still produces a `records` fact. Because `done-missing-record` in graph.ts only checks that some `records` fact exists, a TODO ticked [x] whose only DONE mention says 'in progress' passes the AS2 'completed task lacking an applicable DONE record' check. Expected: only explicit completion wording should create `records`, or non-completion wording should be enumerated more fully. A negative fixture is also expected. Reproduction: DONE body `TODO: 1.1 in progress. Agent: x.` with `- [x] 1.1` in TODO gives no done-missing-record finding.
quality.evidence: status.ts: `const relation = /\b(remain|remains|future|parent|open|deferred)\b/i.test(clause) ? 'refs' : 'records'`. The packet's DONE 20:40 entry reads 'TODO: 1.14.1 complete; 1.14.2–1.14.4 in progress', and its second clause would emit `records` for 1.14.2–1.14.4. status.test.ts has no 'in progress' case.

quality.description: Source applicability is copied into an `applicability` attribute but is never compared with the aircraft or manifest. `dataClass` comes only from the inherited `status` field.
